# RAG with minisdk

Before you start, read [getting started](./getting-started.mdx#connect).

## Ask a question

```python
import asyncio
from minisdk import Rag

async def main():
    rag = Rag("kg")
    print(await rag.ask("who"))

asyncio.run(main())
```

## Configuration

```bash
pip install minisdk
```
